comment: The panel draws an arc marked -5 and +5 around the IN LVL knob, but configParam at thruzero.cpp:51 gives that parameter a range of -2 to 2. The THRESHOLD knob above it carries the same arc and its range really is -5 to 5, so the marking looks copied. The two switches are configured as Off and On for 'Enable spike smoothing' and 'Enable classic XWY flavor', while the panel prints ON/OFF and XWY/ENJ; the XWY switch's Off position is the ENJ flavour. The spike remover is the maker's own description of an imperfect fix: a highpass at 10000Hz drives an envelope follower, and when that follower passes 2.5 the output lowpass drops to 500Hz. CV OUT is named 1V/oct by the maker and is meant for the carrier's FM input rather than for a pitch input directly.
